title: Session handoff 2026-11-19: sonnet renewal after LCLI-797 and LCLI-791 landed; main held, 0.15.0 cut held
description:
Session-handoff record for the lore-cli worker, 2026-11-19, written at the leader's renewal boundary (sonnet successor to sonnet). Restore with opum-workflow:opum-handoff; the live tracker and repository outrank this record. Close it once a successor has restored from it.

STATE, read by ref at write time, not remembered:
- origin/dev == 2aa9c0638ebe083efc09a18237db2639d2b9f13e before this record landed; local dev matches, tree clean, nothing unpushed. origin/main == 7b6176842e18c929039b155706b6a537130993eb, HELD for the pair release (do NOT promote). npm dist-tags unchanged (latest 0.14.1, release-candidate 0.15.0-rc.1). LCLI-775 (the 0.15.0 cut) carries the hold; never publish or move a dist-tag. Never remove, deregister or prune a worktree (DEC-208, LCLI-740): about 60 are registered, including review-734-*, review-735-* and review-737-*.

LANDED THIS SESSION (all on dev, each merged pinned with --match-head-commit): #733 closed the LCLI-798 handoff; #734 LCLI-797 the bin/lore.cjs launcher (99200bc8); #735 + #737 LCLI-791 one quest task list per check/sync run (e8764dfb, 7329ae1f); #736 filed the carrier LCLI-799 (9c57a01c); #738 and #739 recorded the review verdicts verbatim (52262be7, 2aa9c063).

OPEN, in the order to pick them up:
1. LCLI-797 (In Progress, depends on LCLI-799): DEC-282 item 7. AC3 (the child never outlives the wrapper, kill -9 included) is UNCHECKED and completes only with the lifeline carrier LCLI-799 (DEC-282 (a2) item 2: a pipe the wrapper holds, EOF in the child kills its group; item 4: agent-plugins.ts:106's detached children). It is DEC-182 (1) launcher class: sonnet or higher, opus security review, no DeepSeek. LCLI-799 also holds the owed review notes (F1 nested quest native escapes lore's sweep until quest's lifeline QCLI-571; F5, F6, F8, F9). A brief from the leader (DEC-282 (a4)) is coming for the next step; wait for it.
2. LCLI-791 (In Progress): AC3 is UNCHECKED. It needs the 2000-task end-to-end measurement against a PAIR-MATCHED quest 0.15.0 (the local quest is 0.14.1, so the pair lock refuses a real lore run; 0.15.0 is not published and building it is quest-cli's). Plan agreed: a generated .quest of about 2000 records (some in completed/ and archive/) with docs linking about 5% of them plus one all-linked worst case; lore check and sync end to end at the dev base and at the head, each COLD and WARM against the real binary (nothing yet proves a real-binary cache hit); quest spawns counted by a PATH shim logging argv, plus wall time; the list's row count checked against the record count; 4 to 5 concurrent checks with peak quest process count; versions, SHAs and binary paths recorded. Do not measure the replaced operations again. Owed non-blocking items from the #737 review sit in LCLI-791's last note: F1 call-site witness for the cache key, F2 self-alias dedupe test, F4 docblock placement, F5 case folding (lore's toLowerCase against quest's caseFold(NFC) aliasKey, a pair-consistency defect), F7 non-array aliases give not_found not drift. The ambiguity error text (conflict naming task_reference_ambiguous) was not checked against the quest binary's rendered message.
3. LCLI-792 (advisory lock per git common dir with result reuse and stale-holder recovery) and LCLI-793 (managed-block-only drift as a warning by default, an error only under --strict): both DEC-282 items, high, To Do, each needs its OWN brief from the leader before starting. LCLI-794 (low, measurement only), LCLI-790 (medium, mod+hooks, re-read its record first) and LCLI-796 (low, review follow-ups) follow.

OLD LOCAL BRANCHES, checked by ref:
- chore/dec-282-carriers: LANDED. Its one commit (4eef7b84) shipped as PR 726 (MERGED, squashed); it reads as unique only because the squash changed the SHA. Safe to delete with git branch -D.
- diag/LCLI-776-pin-619f02cf (local and on origin): git merge-tree against origin/dev yields exactly dev's tree, so merging it adds nothing; its one commit is a never-merged dispatch proof. Content-contained, safe to delete.
- diag/LCLI-776-macos-14 (local and on origin): NOT fully landed. Three of its four commits (a19297f5, ff38a53d, 34291e9a) are the macos-15 pin chain that shipped as #700 and #701 (ci.yml and release.yml carry macos-15 on dev); the fourth, e8e00597, is an explicit dispatch experiment that was never to be merged. Merging it would change dev, so keep it until the leader says otherwise.
None was deleted by this session.

HOLDS AND RULINGS TO KEEP: do not promote dev to main; do not publish or move a dist-tag; never touch a worktree; hold labels LCLI-646, 760, 775, 776, 781, 782, 786 stay until their own conditions end; LCLI-797 and LCLI-799 are launcher-class (sonnet or higher, opus review, no DeepSeek); LCLI-658 still needs a sonnet-tier route for its hold label.

FACTS THAT COST TIME: gh pr merge --delete-branch also fast-forwards the local dev when run from another branch, and removes the local branch; check git branch --list. Local bun test shows 3 LCLI-614 real-quest race failures (pair lock; CI is the judge). The ubuntu CI leg can red on the Bun epoll EEXIST signature on unrelated tests: rerun the failed job once, name the job and tests, do not retry further. A shell variable cannot be a write target under the ownership guard: use literal paths. Do not chain git push with another command (the composed-push guard drops it); push bare. mutants for bin/lore.cjs tests that wait on a never-exiting wrapper take 60 s each: run them in the background. Quest writes need --actor lore-cli --actor-kind delegated-agent --accountable-human jdnewhouse; long note text goes through a variable read from a file; --add-note appends, --notes replaces.

SKILLS: opum-workflow:opum-handoff (restore), opum-workflow:opum-sdlc, opum-workflow:opum-tool-output.
